text: A mounted figure in dark armor rides a black horse. Helmet obscures face; red eyes visible through eye slits. Armor is metallic, segmented, with shoulder pauldrons. Carries a large axe with curved blade and shield bearing an eagle emblem. Horse has ornate bridle and saddle. Figure holds weapon aloft, posture aggressive. Background shows stormy sky and two birds in flight. No discernible sex or age. Skin tone dark. Hair not visible. Build muscular from armor silhouette.
